data.gender_notes: Darrell is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Darrell is derived from Old English, where it means 'dear one'. In the Middle Ages, it was a popular name for boys born into noble families. The name Darrell carries the meaning “Dear one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Darrell usually hope their child will grow to embody dear one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name signifying love and affection.
data.etymology: Darrell belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dear one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Darrell total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
